name: Music studio
belongs: Making and recording music: songwriting, lyrics, theory, instruments and practice, mixing and mastering, DAWs and plugins as a user, studio gear, room acoustics and home-studio planning, and music analysis or recommendations.
not_here: Writing code for an audio tool (Coding room). Cover art or music video visuals (Art workshop). Choosing background music for a video edit (Art workshop). The business side of a music channel with no music-making question (Mail room).
examples: Give me three budgets for a home studio in a spare bedroom
Where should the desk and monitors go in this room for the best acoustics?
What chords fit over a ii-V-I in B flat?
Help me finish the second verse of this song
